rule.statement: The High Court correctly dismissed the plaint due to misjoinder of parties and causes of action.
rule.supporting_quote: In the circumstances, I hold that the High Court had decided correctly when it held that the Plaint should be dismissed on the ground of misjoinder of parties and causes of action because the Court could not have made any other order as the matters in issue between the relevant parties could not be legally adjudicated in any proper manner due to that reason.
